claim_records.statement: Norsk Musikkarvs prosjektbeskrivelse fører institusjonslinjen fra en komplett kritisk Johan Svendsen-utgave til et bredere, men fortsatt kuratert norsk musikkarvprogram, mens UiBs «Forgotten Voices»-pilot fra 2024–2025 starter i lokale samlinger, flerspråklige verkregistre og navngitte komponistportaler for blant andre Anne Marie Ørbeck, Inger Bang Lund og Borghild Holmsen; sammen viser dokumentene at norsk musikkhistoriografi formes av skiftende kildeutvalg og infrastruktur, men de dokumenterer ikke hele feltets kanon, alle arkivfravær eller effekten av pilotprosjektet.
locators: Norwegian Musical Heritage — About the project: HTML, “The Project”, Johan Svendsen pilot and project origin — The page identifies the complete critical Svendsen edition as the pilot from which the wider project developed.

Norwegian Musical Heritage — About the project: HTML, project description and editorial principles, Preservation, editions and institutions — The page describes a source-critical publication programme for selected Norwegian musical heritage and its institutional partners.

Forgotten Voices in Norwegian Musical Heritage — The Music Archive of the Future: HTML lines 121–129, “Main content” and core point 1, Local collections and multilingual work catalogues — The pilot starts with local collections and names digital catalogues for Grieg, Anne Marie Ørbeck, Fartein Valen and Geirr Tveitt.

Forgotten Voices in Norwegian Musical Heritage — The Music Archive of the Future: HTML lines 130–136, core point 2 and project organisation, Forgotten Voices composer portal — The page names the Bergen partners and the 2023–2024 festival composers used to widen the visible archive corpus.
